title: delurio navigation graph (nav.yaml, nav.extracted.yaml)
description: The pages of an app, the ways between them, and who may open them, in delurio-graph/0 (SPEC.md §6). A nav.yaml (`kind: nav`) may `extends` a generated nav.extracted.yaml (`kind: nav-extracted`), whose pages, guards and entries come first.

kind.description: `nav` for a navigation graph (nav.yaml); `nav-extracted` for the file the extractor generates from the application source (nav.extracted.yaml), which a nav.yaml extends.
The kind of graph file. A nav.yaml is `nav`.

title.description: The app or the part of it this graph covers, in plain words.

summary.description: What the graph shows, in a few plain sentences.

extends.description: A generated file this one extends, relative to it: its pages, guards and entries come first, and this file adds to them or overrides single fields of a page.

locale.description: The locale of the catalog the page uses, a BCP 47 tag.

catalog.description: The catalog of page titles and entry labels, relative to this file: `catalog/<locale>.json`.

frames.description: The chrome around pages (a menu, a top bar), by id. An entry `from: frame:<f>` is on every page of that frame.

facts.description: What is true of the person, not of the page, by name. Every persona gives a value for each fact.

sets.description: Named lists of values, which a persona may give for a fact with `of`.

personas.description: Kinds of user, by id: each a fixed set of facts, so the tool works out each persona's view, menu and reachable pages with no search.

goals.description: Things people come to do: each is checked for every persona it names (the page is reached within the clicks).

notModeled.description: What the graph leaves out, each in words. Quote an item that contains `: `.

allOf.$comment: without extends, the pages are all here: a page called start, and every page gives its route, kind and frame

extracted.description: The generated half of a navigation graph (nav.extracted.yaml), written by `extract` from the application source; never by hand. A person reviews its diff when the application changes.

kind.description: The kind of graph file. A nav.extracted.yaml is `nav-extracted`.

formatVersion.description: The format and its version. Every graph file starts with it.

status.description: `proposed`: written before or apart from the code, nobody has approved it. `captured`: read from existing code (capture mode, every element carries `source`). `approved`: the owner reviewed and accepted it.

expression.description: An expression of delurio's own language (SPEC.md §3) over facts: or, and, not, ==, !=, in, not in, ( ), [lists], 'strings', numbers, true, false, null, and names (a fact or a named guard).

sourceAnchor.description: A source anchor (SPEC.md §9): `<repo-relative path>:<line>`, or a bare `<path>` for a whole file, naming the code that makes the element true.

graphSource.description: Where the graph was read from: the repository, the commit, and the files that hold the pages, the menus and the words. The navigation page shows the repository and the commit.

app.description: The application's folder in the repository.

menu.description: The file that holds the menus.

locales.description: The application's translation files; `{locale}` stands for the locale.

additionalProperties.description: Another file or folder of the application the graph was read from.

extract.description: How the extractor reads the application: its adapter, the names it gives to pages that no menu entry names, the titles it takes, and the locales it copies into catalog/.

adapter.description: The extractor adapter for this application.

names.description: Route to page id, for pages that no menu entry names.

titles.description: Page id to the catalog key of its title.

locales.description: The locales copied into catalog/, as BCP 47 tags.

guards.description: Named guards: each an expression over facts and other guards. A guard may not be written in both the extracted file and nav.yaml with different text.

frame.description: The chrome drawn around a page.

menu.description: The menu the frame carries, by name; a frame without one has none.

shows.description: Its pages draw the menu of the frame that the person's fact names (a page outside any scope shows the menu of the scope the person lands in).

fact.description: The fact whose value names the frame.

values.description: The values the fact can take.

of.description: The fact is a list, drawn from these values (permission codes held, for one); a persona gives a list or the name of a set.

persona.description: A kind of user: a fixed set of facts.

title.description: The persona's name, in the graph's language.

say.description: Who they are, in plain words.

facts.description: A value for every fact: one of its `values`, or for a fact with `of` a list of its values or the name of a set.

additionalProperties.description: The persona's value of the fact.

pages.description: The pages of the app, by id. A page called `start` is required (in nav.yaml or the file it extends).

page.description: A page. In a nav.yaml that extends a generated file, a page of that file may give single fields to override.

route.description: The page's route; `{id}` stands for a path parameter.

title.description: The page's title: a catalog key, or plain words.

kind.description: `screen`, `placeholder` (says it is not ready), `missing` (the server answers not found), `redirect` or `external`.

frame.description: The frame drawn around the page.

opensFor.description: The guard under which the page opens; it refuses everyone else.

refusal.description: How the page says no, in words.

pageCodes.description: Generated: the name of the permission codes that open the page, as the application's permission table names them.

evidence.description: The code that shows the page's kind or gate, in words.

entries.description: The ways from page to page.

entry.description: A way from page to page.

id.description: The entry's id; `<from>><to>#<line>` when left out.

from.description: The page it starts at, `frame:<frame>` for every page of a frame, or a list of those.

how.description: `auto` (a redirect, no click), `menu`, `picker` (a scope picker), `user` (the person row), `link` or `button`.

label.description: Its words: a catalog key, or plain words. Every entry but an `auto` one has a label.

when.description: The guard under which the entry is offered.

clicks.description: How many clicks it takes; 0 for `auto`, else 1 when left out.

data.description: `true` when it needs an item to exist (a row to click).

allOf.$comment: every entry but an auto one has a label

for.description: The personas it is checked for.

within.description: The most clicks it may take from `start`.
